digest.component_or_area: review-bot LLM provider, Bedrock integration, production gate safety net
propositions: The production review-bot must be configured to use Bedrock inference profiles as its LLM backend instead of the direct Anthropic API, with per-pass model class slots (frontier→opus, standard→sonnet, trivial→haiku) replacing a single scalar model knob.

The review-bot container image must include the bedrock extra in its uv sync installation so pydantic_ai.providers.bedrock can be imported; without this the first Bedrock call fails with LLMConfigError and the gate stops voting on all landings to main.

The cutover must be preceded by a proven safety net: a kill switch demonstrating the bot can revert to Anthropic, a bedrock-native CloudWatch alarm measuring InvokeModel client-error rate > 25% over 15 minutes, and an induced VOTER_ERROR observed transitioning rebar-gerrit-voter-errors from OK to ALARM on the pre-cutover Anthropic path.

Cross-provider fallback must not exist; a Bedrock outage must fail closed (refusing to vote) rather than silently falling back to Anthropic, and transient fault handling relies on botocore stock defaults rather than rebar-configured retry envelopes.

The per-pass model split already exists in landed code (code-review.yaml and plan-review.yaml declare model_ladder and per-class overrides); the cutover is purely additive configuration via three class-slot env vars, not a design or code change.
